name: LM-432 crab droid
description: The LM-432 "Muckraker" crab droid, commonly referred to as the crab droid or simply "Muckraker," was a six-legged droid walker of various sizes manufactured by the Techno Union. There were other models of this droid that had four legs. They were used by the Confederacy of Independent Systems during the Clone Wars.
